# Checking your work

After a change, run `./ise check`. If a requirement fails or parts clash, fix it before you answer, unless the person asked for something that cannot meet it; then say exactly what fails and why. Never claim something works without the engine's word for it. Add requirements (`intent.requirement.create`) for what matters: no clashes, envelopes, mass limits, clearances.
